description: This bar chart illustrates the sample count for two distinct categories across four text genres. The horizontal axis displays the categorical variables, ordered from left to right as Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository, without an explicit axis label. The vertical axis represents the numerical values, labeled "Sample Count," utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 120 with tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 20. The chart employs grouped vertical bars, where each genre on the horizontal axis features a pair of side-by-side bars. As indicated by the legend in the upper center, the left bar in each group is colored blue-grey and represents the "Open" category, while the right bar is colored mauve-grey and represents the "Cons." category. Every bar is visually emphasized with an exact numerical annotation placed directly above it. For the "Open" category, the annotated values are 79 for Argumentative, 80 for Narrative, 68 for Descriptive, and 62 for Expository. For the "Cons." category, the values are 122 for Argumentative, 87 for Narrative, 100 for Descriptive, and 130 for Expository. The shortest bar in the chart corresponds to the "Open" category within the Expository genre at 62, whereas the tallest bar corresponds to the "Cons." category within the same Expository genre at 130. The groups on the horizontal axis are not sorted in a strictly ascending or descending numerical order.
